note: Deterministic selection cases for scripts/library_router.py. Executed by scripts/check_router_selection.py with no model in the loop, so every row is reproducible on a clean checkout. This is NOT a PS-D028 model-run suite and deliberately carries no suite.yaml: the question here is whether a pure function returns the right identifier or the right refusal, which is decided by running it.

shipped.note: scripts/settings.example.json exactly as shipped: ask-and-confirm, no auto-select, released-only eligibility.

auto.note: Auto-select enabled and built packages eligible. This is the profile under which top-1 accuracy is measurable at all; under the shipped profile every SINGLE request correctly returns ask.

auto_released_only.note: Auto-select enabled but only released packages eligible — the status guard.

auto_csr_disabled.note: Auto-select enabled with one package disabled by the operator.

force_ddi.note: Operator has forced one skill for this invocation.

force_ddi_disabled.note: Contradictory operator configuration: the forced skill is also disabled. Must fail closed.
